name: Native Wayland/X11/GNOME/KDE on a jailbroken iPad

mentions.name: Native Wayland/X11/GNOME/KDE on a jailbroken iPad
mentions.description: A project that compiles and runs Wayland, X11, GNOME, KDE, and the Ladybird browser natively on a jailbroken iPad, built with the help of AI coding tools (Claude, Codex). More details are planned for release, with an early wiki documenting the effort at xios.maxleiter.com.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I (and Claude, codex, etc) have compiled/ran wayland, X11, GNOME, KDE, and Ladybird natively on a jailbroken iPad. Hoping to release more details soon but I have a slop wiki here:

https://xios.maxleiter.com
mentions.author: MaxLeiter
